greetings.text: Hullo, and welcome. Do sit down.
Ah, there you are. We were beginning to wonder.
Keep close. I don't like how quiet it's grown.
Well met. Mind the shadows, they're full of ears here.

farewells.text: Good day to you. Mind the road.
I must be off. There's a deal to see to.

smalltalk.text: The Old Forest has a bad name, and I'm not fond of it. But I know its ways better than most.
I like maps. A map can tell you what to expect, but never what you'll find.
Crickhollow's snug. It'll do very well for Frodo's retirement.
There's more to Frodo's plan than he lets on. I've said nothing. Yet.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: The Sackville-Bagginses have Bag End now, so Frodo says. I think he's well out of it, whatever the price.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk on the Road? There's been a deal of talk in Buckland, aye. Big Folk and worse. I take no side, but I keep the doors barred.
